{ "item": { "id": "bce51306-4e33-491c-b48d-77941d0044ed", "content_type": "generic", "workflow_state": "public", "page_title": "Quickstart", "short_description": "Go from zero to a running pipeline in five minutes.", "body": "

Quickstart

\n

The fastest path from zero to a running pipeline.

\n\n

1. Get an API key

\n

See Authentication if you don't have one yet.

\n\n

2. Create a pipeline

\n{{ds:component/code-block|filename=terminal|language=bash|code=curl -X POST https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2/pipelines \\\n -H \"Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY\" \\\n -d '{\"name\":\"my-first-pipeline\",\"source_connector_id\":\"conn_demo_source\",\"destination_connector_id\":\"conn_demo_dest\"}'}}\n\n

3. Watch it run

\n

Subscribe to pipeline.completed via Webhooks, or poll the Events endpoint to see events as they're processed.

\n\n{{ds:component/alert|variant=success|title=That's it|body_html=

For a fuller walkthrough with a real source and destination, go to Building your first pipeline in the Guides section.

}}\n\n{{ds:component/docs-pagination|prev_href={{cms:item/0d0c5a67-ddfd-45fa-b23c-796c67d5784e}}|prev_label=Installation|next_href={{cms:item/67e28ef9-df46-446a-9839-8f4bd0b23de1}}|next_label=Authentication}}", "version_token": "2c0a95a6-cab5-48b2-8870-5bab8cf4e0b3", "created_at": "2026-08-21T15:33:43.212Z", "updated_at": "2026-08-21T15:33:53.120Z", "placement_id": "92f88acb-393a-4efd-bb47-cc71ee93a4d8", "folder_id": "322c19f5-4faa-4063-9f8b-5761320e7db4", "file_name": "getting-started-quickstart" } }

{ "item": { "id": "673b0f52-a921-429d-b1d2-65487d8c37cb", "content_type": "generic", "workflow_state": "public", "page_title": "Authentication", "short_description": "Authenticate API requests with a bearer API key.", "body": "

Authentication

\n

Every request to the Godzilla API is authenticated with a bearer API key.

\n\n

Getting an API key

\n

Generate one from your workspace settings. Keys are scoped to a single workspace and inherit the standard rate limit described in Rate limits & errors.

\n\n

Using the key

\n{{ds:component/code-block|filename=terminal|language=bash|code=curl https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2/pipelines \\\n -H \"Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY\"}}\n\n{{ds:component/alert|variant=danger|title=Never expose a key client-side|body_html=

API keys carry full workspace access. Keep them server-side only — never embed one in a mobile app, browser bundle, or public repository.

}}\n\n

Verifying webhook requests

\n

Incoming webhook deliveries are authenticated differently: by a signed X-Godzilla-Signature header rather than your API key.

\n\n{{ds:component/docs-pagination|prev_href={{cms:item/1aaa9856-f563-4263-929f-16e234970286}}|prev_label=Quickstart|next_href={{cms:item/2df76640-838b-4256-956e-d8a19a602241}}|next_label=Building your first pipeline}}", "version_token": "0d231fd3-63ab-4f5b-8845-129136ecdfe5", "created_at": "2026-08-21T15:33:43.241Z", "updated_at": "2026-08-21T15:33:53.135Z", "placement_id": "a8665e39-d994-43d7-9f40-791673ac7d44", "folder_id": "322c19f5-4faa-4063-9f8b-5761320e7db4", "file_name": "getting-started-authentication" } }

{ "item": { "id": "2df76640-838b-4256-956e-d8a19a602241", "content_type": "generic", "workflow_state": "public", "page_title": "Building your first pipeline", "short_description": "Create a source connector, a destination connector, and the pipeline that connects them, end to end.", "body": "

Building your first pipeline

This guide walks through creating a pipeline end to end: a source connector, a destination connector, and the pipeline that ties them together.

{{ds:component/alert|variant=info|title=Before you start|body_html=

You'll need an API key. See Authentication in Getting Started if you don't have one yet.

}}

1. Create a source connector

We'll pull orders from Postgres. See Connectors for the full catalog of types.

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=create-source.sh|language=bash|code=curl -X POST https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2/connectors \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY" \ -d '{"type":"postgres","direction":"source","config":{"connection_string":"postgres://..."}}'}}

2. Create a destination connector

We'll write to Snowflake.

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=create-destination.sh|language=bash|code=curl -X POST https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2/connectors \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY" \ -d '{"type":"snowflake","direction":"destination","config":{"account":"..."}}'}}

3. Create the pipeline

Full request/response details are in the Pipelines endpoint reference.

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=create-pipeline.sh|language=bash|code=curl -X POST https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2/pipelines \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY" \ -d '{"name":"ingest-orders","source_connector_id":"conn_pg_orders","destination_connector_id":"conn_snowflake_dw"}'}}

The pipeline starts in draft state. Activate it once you're ready to start processing events.

input.body:
Authentication

Every request to the Godzilla API is authenticated with a bearer API key.

Getting an API key

Generate one from your workspace settings. Keys are scoped to a single workspace and inherit the standard rate limit described in Rate limits & errors.

Using the key

Bash / curl

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=terminal|language=bash|code=curl https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2/pipelines \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY"}}

Go

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=main.go|language=go|code=package main import ( "context" "log" "os" "github.com/godzilla-io/godzilla-go" ) func main() { // The client automatically reads GODZILLA_API_KEY from the environment client := godzilla.NewClient(os.Getenv("GODZILLA_API_KEY")) pipelines, err := client.Pipelines.List(context.Background()) if err != nil { log.Fatalf("Failed to list pipelines: %v", err) } log.Printf("Found %d pipelines\n", len(pipelines)) }}} {{ds:component/alert|variant=danger|title=Never expose a key client-side|body_html=

API keys carry full workspace access. Keep them server-side only — never embed one in a mobile app, browser bundle, or public repository.

}}

Verifying webhook requests

Incoming webhook deliveries are authenticated differently: by a signed X-Godzilla-Signature header rather than your API key.

{{ds:component/docs-pagination|prev_href={{cms:item/1aaa9856-f563-4263-929f-16e234970286}}|prev_label=Quickstart|next_href={{cms:item/2df76640-838b-4256-956e-d8a19a602241}}|next_label=Building your first pipeline}}

input.body:
Building your first pipeline

This guide walks through creating a pipeline end to end: a source connector, a destination connector, and the pipeline that ties them together.

{{ds:component/alert|variant=info|title=Before you start|body_html=

You'll need an API key. See Authentication in Getting Started if you don't have one yet.

}}

1. Create a source connector

We'll pull orders from Postgres. See Connectors for the full catalog of types.

Bash / curl

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=create-source.sh|language=bash|code=curl -X POST https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2/connectors \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY" \ -d '{"type":"postgres","direction":"source","config":{"connection_string":"postgres://..."}}'}}

Go

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=main.go|language=go|code=package main import ( "context" "log" "os" "github.com/godzilla-io/godzilla-go" ) func main() { client := godzilla.NewClient(os.Getenv("GODZILLA_API_KEY")) sourceConnector, err := client.Connectors.Create(context.Background(), &godzilla.CreateConnectorRequest{ Type: "postgres", Direction: "source", Config: map[string]interface{}{ "connection_string": "postgres://...", }, }) if err != nil { log.Fatalf("Failed to create source connector: %v", err) } log.Printf("Created source connector: %s\n", sourceConnector.ID) }}}

2. Create a destination connector

We'll write to Snowflake.

Bash / curl

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=create-destination.sh|language=bash|code=curl -X POST https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2/connectors \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY" \ -d '{"type":"snowflake","direction":"destination","config":{"account":"..."}}'}}

Go

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=main.go|language=go|code=package main import ( "context" "log" "os" "github.com/godzilla-io/godzilla-go" ) func main() { client := godzilla.NewClient(os.Getenv("GODZILLA_API_KEY")) destinationConnector, err := client.Connectors.Create(context.Background(), &godzilla.CreateConnectorRequest{ Type: "snowflake", Direction: "destination", Config: map[string]interface{}{ "account": "...", }, }) if err != nil { log.Fatalf("Failed to create destination connector: %v", err) } log.Printf("Created destination connector: %s\n", destinationConnector.ID) }}}

3. Create the pipeline

Full request/response details are in the Pipelines endpoint reference.

Bash / curl

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=create-pipeline.sh|language=bash|code=curl -X POST https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2/pipelines \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY" \ -d '{"name":"ingest-orders","source_connector_id":"conn_pg_orders","destination_connector_id":"conn_snowflake_dw"}'}}

Go

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=main.go|language=go|code=package main import ( "context" "log" "os" "github.com/godzilla-io/godzilla-go" ) func main() { client := godzilla.NewClient(os.Getenv("GODZILLA_API_KEY")) pipeline, err := client.Pipelines.Create(context.Background(), &godzilla.CreatePipelineRequest{ Name: "ingest-orders", SourceConnectorID: "conn_pg_orders", DestinationConnectorID: "conn_snowflake_dw", }) if err != nil { log.Fatalf("Failed to create pipeline: %v", err) } log.Printf("Created pipeline: %s (state: %s)\n", pipeline.ID, pipeline.State) }}}

The pipeline starts in draft state. Activate it once you're ready to start processing events.

Next steps

Now that events are flowing, read Handling errors & retries to see what happens when a write fails, or Monitoring & alerts to watch it run.

{{ds:component/docs-pagination|prev_href={{cms:item/60d7d27a-ceda-4034-b98e-8b1181ca5c84}}|prev_label=Guides|next_href={{cms:item/3448ffab-598c-46e7-bda6-e7cdc4a1e7c6}}|next_label=Connecting a data source}}
